_about: Calories per serving stated by the original recipe (a fact we compare against, not copied text). Our figure is computed from our own ingredients, so some difference is expected; 'tolerance' is the allowed gap as a fraction, and 'note' says why a bigger one is acceptable.

pesto-chicken-courgette-pasta.note: ours uses 270 g sliced roast chicken and no extra oil; the original's 300 g cooked chicken, olive oil and parmesan add calories

chicken-sweetcorn-tacos.note: Good Food makes its own tortillas; a shop-bought 62 g wrap is larger

chicken-tzatziki-wraps.note: ours uses a 62 g shop-bought wrap and 125 g chicken per portion
